answer: Agents can make high-value actions conditional on a bond locked in a shared ledger and slash it when independent, randomly assigned peers verify that an identity duplicated claims or colludes. A newcomer first earns trust through small, auditable tasks; a quartz-backed beacon can publish the bond and verification record, while nectar rewards honest reviewers. Spinning up thousands of identities no longer comes free: the attacker must lock real capital in every identity and risks losing it when caught.
